title: MESSAGES OF THANKS: DISPATCHERS SHARE WHY MARTEN IS SO GRATEFUL FOR OUR DRIVERS
summary: As Thanksgiving approaches, we’re reminded of the people who make this season—and every season—run smoothly. At Marten, that gratitude begins with our drivers. body_text: As Thanksgiving approaches, we’re reminded of the people who make this season—and every season—run smoothly. At Marten, that gratitude begins with our drivers. The long hours, the miles, the commitment to safety, the sacrifices made away from home—these actions fuel our success, our customers’ success, and the communities that rely on timely deliveries during the holidays. To celebrate this season of thanks, we asked members of our dispatch team to share stories about the drivers they work with every day. Their messages tell the tale clearly: Marten drivers are exceptional. “Drivers are the backbone of this company.” – Chad A. Christie Now in his 15th year with Marten, Chad says the best part of his job has always been the drivers themselves. “I’ve always enjoyed building relationships and learning from them. Fifteen years ago, I had zero transportation experience—our drivers taught me what life is really like on the road.” One of his favorite memories? Presenting Million Mile Safe Driving Awards. “If being on the road for one or two million miles and doing it safely isn’t above and beyond, I don’t know what is. It’s amazing to play even a small part in honoring their professionalism.” Chad’s message of thanks: “Your hard work keeps this country moving. Through long hours and unpredictable weather, you deliver safely and professionally. Your sacrifices don’t go unnoticed.” “Their teamwork was incredible.” – Ryan E. Cooper Ryan has spent sixteen years supporting drivers as they grow their careers—and their dedication still impresses him. Recently, he watched three drivers work together to keep freight moving in a challenging situation. One driver in Weed, CA, waited hours to relay a load, ensuring it could continue to Rice Hill, OR, for a third driver to finish. “All three loads arrived on time. Their teamwork was incredible.” Ryan especially enjoys recognizing his Million Mile and Driver Mentor drivers with bomber jackets: “It’s an honor to present those awards.” His message of gratitude: “We are most thankful for your commitment to safety and premier service. You are truly the top of the field, and it is our pride that you drive with us.” “They show up and perform an extremely difficult job.” – Blake E. Baty In his ten years with Marten, Blake says the trust between operations and drivers is what stands out most. “Our drivers work hard to execute the plans we put in place—maximizing their miles and getting them home to spend time with their families.” One story he’ll never forget: a driver who prevented a trailer from being stolen by noticing something was off, calling dispatch, and confronting the unauthorized individual. “Her quick thinking protected our equipment and our freight.” Another highlight was watching a driver he once managed grow from struggling early on to becoming one of the hardest-working, award-winning drivers on his board. “I consider him a friend for life.” Blake’s message of thanks: “Thank you for showing up every day and doing a difficult job in the safest way possible. Your work ethic is unmatched.” “They move Marten forward.” – Clint E. Talley Clint has spent twelve years at Marten and says the most meaningful part of his job is getting to know drivers personally and helping them achieve their goals. A recent example of a driver going above and beyond happened when last-minute trailers needed to be spotted over the weekend. “He had just delivered and was heading home. We called, explained the situation, and he enthusiastically said, ‘Yes!’” His favorite memory goes back to his early career—coordinating an overnight load of crawfish from Louisiana to Nashville. “If it didn’t arrive in time, 22,000 people wouldn’t have crawfish. I worked with our best driver to create a plan. The next morning, it was sitting in Nashville. A cool moment.” Clint’s message of thanks: “Thank you for everything you do. Your focus on safety and commitment to moving Marten forward will help us come out of this freight recession stronger than ever.” A Season for Gratitude Across every story, a few themes are consistent: Sacrifice—time away from home, long hours, and unpredictable conditions. Teamwork—drivers stepping up for each other, customers, and operations. Professionalism—delivering safely, consistently, and with pride. During the holidays, these efforts matter more than ever. Increased traffic, tighter schedules, and winter weather make the season challenging, yet Marten drivers continue to deliver so families across the country can celebrate with full tables and full shelves. To every Marten driver: thank you. Your dedication keeps our customers moving, supports our communities, and makes Marten stronger every day. We are grateful—this season and every season—to have the very best behind the wheel.

title: VSee Boosts Telehealth Visits 88% for Major Kidney Care Provider
summary: One of the nation’s largest kidney dialysis providers achieved an 88% increase in successful telehealth visits after integrating VSee’s telehealth solution with Oracle Health EHR (formerly Cerner).…
body_text: One of the nation’s largest kidney dialysis providers achieved an 88% increase in successful telehealth visits after integrating VSee’s telehealth solution with Oracle Health EHR (formerly Cerner). This project highlights VSee’s ease-of-use for low‑tech patients, customizability for streamlined workflows, and fast EHR integration expertise (6 weeks of engineering work). The Impact 88% increase in successful telehealth visit completion Simplified patient access with direct 1‑click SMS video links Reduced scheduling work by half with automatic syncing of appointments between VSee and the EHR Faster care coordination with patient and provider chat channels and tags The Challenge This leading kidney care provider serves mostly seniors and lower-income patients. With approximately 30% patient portal adoption and many patients lacking email access, patients struggled to complete the steps to join telehealth visits. Staff productivity was also affected by double scheduling in both Oracle Health EHR and VSee, and they lacked options in the EHR to personalize reminders and schedule pre-appointment device testing without cluttering the EHR schedule. The Solution VSee partnered closely with the provider’s IT and clinical teams to provide a custom telehealth solution integrated with the provider’s Oracle Health EHR. Streamlined Appointments Now, once an appointment is scheduled in the EHR, it automatically syncs with VSee, eliminating double entry. The team can customize appointment reminders and messages directly from the EHR. Providers can conduct a pre‑visit test call without creating an actual appointment in the schedule. Simpler Communications Communication is simpler and clearer with separate internal and patient chat channels and offers one-click escalation options to phone or video. A digital queue with tagging, and automated notifications also supports smooth handoffs. Empowered Reporting and Configurations Administrators can easily manage waiting rooms, users, scheduling, and generate custom analytics. Ongoing Support Finally, VSee supported the entire rollout with onboarding and branded training and continues to provide ongoing training and support. The Result After a total of 6 weeks engineering effort, a previously complex process that depended on patient portal access is now a simple, user‑friendly system that even non‑tech‑savvy patients can use with ease. Patients receive clear instruction and custom reminders before their visits, helping them feel prepared. The care team can create, track, and conduct telehealth appointments directly in the EHR without clutter or extra manual work, allowing the team to focus more on what really matters. A big note of gratitude to the VSee team for all the attention, effort, and hard work this week. Happy that we are moving forward with our go-live plan on schedule. – Director of Provider Strategy & Operations Why Partner with VSee Fast customizability – no-code/low-code building blocks High security – HIPAA-compliant, FedRAMP High authorization Robust scalability – field-tested on 1.5 million monthly video encounters Lowest lifecycle costs – make modifications even after deployment If you want a telehealth partner that keeps things practical and easy to run, VSee is ready to help .
